from math import sin

schema T scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    z: Float mutable
    one: Float mutable
    two: Float mutable
    three: Float mutable
    half: Float mutable
    big: Float mutable

rule sin_pos_zero_is_pos_zero:
    T t where (sin(t.z) == 0.0) and ((1.0 / sin(t.z)) is inf)
->
    log info "a"

rule sin_neg_zero_is_neg_zero:
    T t where (sin(-t.z) == 0.0) and ((1.0 / sin(-t.z)) is -inf)
->
    log info "b"

rule sin_pos_inf_is_nan:
    T t where sin(t.big * t.big) is NaN
->
    log info "c"

rule sin_neg_inf_is_nan:
    T t where sin(-(t.big * t.big)) is NaN
->
    log info "d"
